title: Framework CI lacked enforceable security-scanner and workflow-evidence coverage
title_de: Framework-CI fehlte durchsetzbare Coverage für Security-Scanner und Workflow-Evidence
summary: Framework CI security checks lacked a semantic proof that required scanner and evidence commands were executable on the intended pull-request path.
summary_de: Framework-CI-Security-Checks fehlte ein semantischer Nachweis, dass erforderliche Scanner- und Evidence-Befehle auf dem vorgesehenen Pull-Request-Pfad ausführbar waren.
observed_behavior: A raw presence-style contract could accept comments, dead control flow, or uncalled helper bodies as satisfying required commands.
observed_behavior_de: Ein reiner Vorhandenseins-Contract konnte Kommentare, toten Kontrollfluss oder nicht aufgerufene Helper-Bodies als erfüllte erforderliche Befehle akzeptieren.
expected_behavior: Required commands must be structurally reachable from the checked workflow step root.
expected_behavior_de: Erforderliche Befehle müssen vom Root des geprüften Workflow-Steps strukturell erreichbar sein.
impact: A pull request could preserve required scanner text while preventing execution and emitting misleading later evidence.
impact_de: Ein Pull Request könnte erforderlichen Scanner-Text behalten, dessen Ausführung verhindern und später irreführende Evidence erzeugen.
acceptance_criteria: Comments, recognized control-flow bodies, uncalled POSIX/Bash helpers, and commands after direct exit cannot satisfy required-command checks.
Legitimate nested OSV helpers remain accepted when directly reachable.
Exact final PR-head CI and review evidence confirms the committed control.
validation_plan: Run the semantic evidence unit suite and make test-ci-security-contract.
Run make lint, locked Ruff, actionlint, and zizmor at the exact final local head.
Observe exact final PR-head remote CI and review evidence after the normal push.

evidence.command: rtk env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 BUILD_ROOT=<task-build-root> make PYTHON=<framework-venv-python> lint

root_cause: The original contract was textual and did not model shell reachability or function invocation.
root_cause_de: Der ursprüngliche Contract war textuell und modellierte weder Shell-Erreichbarkeit noch Funktionsaufrufe.
proposed_remediation: Implemented a narrow fail-closed semantic evidence checker with negative and legitimate-control regressions.
proposed_remediation_de: Einen engen fail-closed semantischen Evidence-Checker mit negativen und legitimen Kontroll-Regressionen implementiert.
legitimate_control_tests: Current OSV nested helper flow passes the semantic contract.
dependencies: Exact final PR-head remote CI, SonarQube Cloud, review, and thread evidence.
residual_risk: Local remediation is verified but exact final PR-head external evidence is pending.
residual_risk_de: Die lokale Remediation ist verifiziert, aber externe Exact-Final-PR-Head-Evidence steht aus.

history.detail: Independent review reproduced and then confirmed closure of comments, control-flow, exit, and uncalled-helper bypasses; source commit 768a06b is locally validated.
